question: Should OpenClaw core accept default-off agent-elected continuation with durable delegate queues and opt-in cross-session trusted enrichment?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: it changes core agent lifecycle semantics, model-facing tools, config defaults, persisted TaskFlow/session state, and a security-sensitive cross-session enrichment policy.

options.title: Sponsor default-off continuation
options.body: Accept the feature direction after the status-row fix and branch refresh, keeping cross-session targeting default-deny and requiring upgrade/security proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the core surface
options.body: Ask the author to reduce this to a smaller experimental or plugin-owned continuation seam before core owns durable continuation semantics.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Defer or close until maintainers decide that model-elected continuation and cross-session enrichment belong in OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-off continuation
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction after the status-row fix and branch refresh, keeping cross-session targeting default-deny and requiring upgrade/security proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this continuation shape and explicitly deferred the cross-session targeting/product-policy decision to maintainers.
